Proposed hearing

Proposed public hearing: AI and cybersecurity

Jorge Seif submits request 102/2026 to CCT. On the 25 November agenda; hearing date not yet confirmed.

Back to listing ↗

Senator Jorge Seif (PL/SC) submitted request 102/2026 to the Science, Technology, Innovation and Informatics Committee (CCT) on 18 November. It proposes a hearing on autonomous agents, frontier artificial intelligence and their cybersecurity implications.

The proposed discussion covers US-China technology competition and risks to essential services. The text suggests government, military and private-sector representatives, without confirming attendance.

As checked on 21 November 2026, the request is on the agenda for CCT’s deliberative meeting on 25 November at 10 a.m., Brasília time. The hearing date remains unconfirmed.

Source: Senado Federal
